messages:
Alex: Hey team — thinking of doing a drop-in LAN sesh this Saturday around 6pm in the office common area. Bring consoles, laptops, controllers, whatever. Who's in?
Maria: I can bring my Switch + Smash. Need 2 joycons? I have a pro controller too. :smile: 
Jon: In for PC stuff. Can we run a Steam co-op queue? Also ping @Sam about the network config — will we need a dedicated switch/segment?
Priya: Count me in. I can bring a couple of monitors and power strips. FYI we only have 3 surge protectors in the common area.
Sam: Yep I can bring a small unmanaged switch and an extra router. I can VLAN the LAN sesh traffic so it doesn't hit corp network. I'll bring an ethernet cable bundle (Cat6).
Jen: Ooh also idea — small gift swap: if you want to bring a Steam/console game voucher (~$10-20) we can raffle them during breaks. Good for new indie finds. Thoughts? :gift:
Alex: Love the gift-swap idea. If people prefer digital, we can do Steam gift links or Switch eShop codes. No pressure tho.
Maria: I'm down for the raffle. I can throw in a 10$ eShop card.
Jon: Quick tech Q — what IP range should we use for the local game servers? Sam?
Sam: I'll set up a small LAN DHCP on the router: 10.42.0.100-10.42.0.200. I'll also throw up a tiny CS:GO lobby or Minecraft server for anyone who wants.
Alex: Nice. If someone wants to host a lobby, drop the IP in thread. Maybe pin it to the channel before we start.
Priya: Can someone bring extra HDMI -> DisplayPort adapters? My monitor is DP-only.
Jen: I have 2 adapters I can bring.
Jon: Also can we have a chill corner for consoles and a louder corner for shooters? Good to avoid accidental rage. :joy:
Maria: agreed. couch + Switch in the chill corner is perfect.
lobby-bot: Reminder: office space booking confirmed for 6pm-11pm. Please follow office guest policy.
Alex: Thanks lobby-bot! Last thing — anyone need a controller? I have one spare Xbox wireless pad.
Priya: Might borrow that if it's still free.
Sam: Server IP for Minecraft testbed (will be up around 5:30pm): `10.42.0.150:25565`
Jon: Sweet. I'll preload some co-op mods. Anyone want the Steam group link?
Alex: Posted it: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/redwood-lan (also I'll drop a short pinned checklist: bring cables, controllers, snacks, chargers)
Jen: Snacks signup? I can bring chips + soda. Who wants to coordinate food?
Maria: I can grab a pizza — pepperoni + veggie. Vote with reactions.
Alex: Awesome. React to this thread for commits. See you Saturday! :party_popper:
